title: Measured and reported data
subtitle: Four measured source types, processed on a direct or hybrid path and reconciled at the aggregator.

cems.title: CEMS
cems.desc: Real-time stack monitoring at 15-minute intervals. Direct GHG measurement.

utility.title: Utility meters
utility.desc: Electricity, gas, water and steam meters with automated reading capture.

verified.title: Third-party verified
verified.desc: Data audited by accredited verification bodies (SGS, Bureau Veritas and others).

lab.title: Stack tests and lab
lab.desc: Periodic emission sampling, fuel analysis and material composition testing.

normalise.title: Normalise
normalise.desc: Convert units, standardise timestamps, align intervals

qa.title: Quality assurance
qa.desc: Outlier detection, gap filling, completeness scoring

classify.title: Classify and tag scope
classify.desc: Map to GHG scope and source category

direct.title: Direct path
direct.subtitle: Bypasses calculators
direct.desc: Pre-calculated or directly measured emissions need no calculator module. CEMS data and verified totals take this path.

hybrid.title: Hybrid path
hybrid.subtitle: Partial calculation
hybrid.desc: Measured activity data that still needs an emission factor or a unit conversion in a calculator module.

rules.cemsVsCalc: CEMS vs calculated: prefer CEMS when the difference is under 5%
rules.meterVsInvoice: Utility meter vs invoice: flag when the difference exceeds 2%
rules.verifiedOverride: Certified verified totals override calculated values
rules.labOverride: Lab results override emission factors for tested fuel batches
rules.gapFill: Gap fill: interpolate CEMS gaps of up to 72 hours

processing.shareAria: Share of records by processing path

cems.reason: Direct GHG measurement, no calculation needed

electricity.reason: kWh measured; needs a grid emission factor

gas.reason: Volume and composition known; direct CO₂e

fuel.reason: Composition data routes to the combustion calculator

process.reason: Material balance routes to the process-emissions calculator

steps.1: Measured and calculated data enter the aggregator
steps.3: The best-quality source wins; the difference is logged
